title: Algebraic spaces and their etale line modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. An algebraic space over $S$ is a sheaf of sets $F$ on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] whose diagonal $F\to F\times F$ is representable and which admits a representable surjective etale map $h_U\to F$ for a scheme $U$ over $S$. Here $h_U(T)=\operatorname{Mor}_S(T,U)$ and morphisms of algebraic spaces are natural transformations. A map $G\to F$ of sheaves is representable if for each scheme $T$ and each $h_T\to F$, the sheaf fibre product $h_T\times_FG$ is represented by a scheme; such a map is etale, respectively surjective, when all these scheme projections are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], respectively surjective. The small etale site $F_{\mathrm{et}}$ consists of schemes $T$ with an etale map $h_T\to F$, with jointly surjective etale covering families. Its structure sheaf has $\mathcal O_F(T)=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$. A line module on $F$ means a sheaf of $\mathcal O_F$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O_F$ on this site; these are called invertible modules here. Pullback along an etale map is restriction on the localized etale sites.

proof.text: For isEtale_comp, apply the scheme-test definition twice to obtain W -> V -> T and two representing pullback squares. Paste the squares vertically (IsPullback.paste_vert) and use composition of etale scheme morphisms for W -> T. This works for arbitrary presheaves and does not choose an atlas.

For an etale scheme map r, use yoneda.preimage on a test map into its target. The scheme pullback of r represents the presheaf pullback because Yoneda preserves limits; its projection is etale by base change. For a covering arrow a:U->T and any b:V->T in the small site, form the scheme pullback P=U times_T V in Over S. Its projection to V is etale, so composition gives an etale chart P->F. The projections are morphisms of the small site and give a pullback there: etaleForget reflects pullbacks as the composite of a fully faithful inclusion and connected-limit-creating comma/over projections. Thus covering pullbacks exist and etaleForget preserves them.

Identify etalePrecoverage with the comap of Scheme.etalePrecoverage along etaleForget by writing a presieve as ofArrows and checking joint surjectivity and etaleness. The preceding pullback construction and scheme covering base-change give stability under base change. Mathlib Functor.isContinuous_toGrothendieck_of_pullbacksPreservedBy then proves continuity of etaleForget. The adopted source theorem Scheme.isSheaf_Γ says that global sections form a sheaf for every subcanonical topology, and the same source supplies subcanonicity of the big etale topology through fppf descent. Restrict that sheaf along etaleForget. Apply the already proved liftedRingForgetHasSheafCompose to forget commutativity, preserving the independent site and ring universes. This proves structurePresheaf_isSheaf.

For etaleMap, the composite with the target etaleForget is definitionally the source etaleForget. Preservation of pairwise covering pullbacks follows by reflection along the target etaleForget. The image of a covering family is covering because its underlying schemes and maps are unchanged; check this through precoverage_eq_comap and ofArrows. Apply the same Mathlib precoverage continuity criterion to obtain etaleMap_isContinuous. The explicit definitions of structureSheaf and module pullback then have their required proofs.
